biomes.biomeDescription: These dark lands are filled with fire and water - hostile, haunted  lands.
Only the pure will survive these cleansing fires.
Are you scared of the dark?
Welcome to the desert! New enemies an bosses await! But be wary of the storms...
Stronger and more enemies will hunt you down in these wilder dunes
Can you survive the sands of the apocalypse?
these grasslands are filled with challenging, but managable enemies. Good luck!
Don't be fooled by these friendly fields - stronger foes await you here!
Only the strongest survive in this land. No mistakes are forgiven.
